Later compose problems were first-try correct, at position 8 (p97) and elsewhere (p91, p26, p52, p75, p100). Review compose 10 + 8 = ? (p138) was also first-try correct. The late position did not lead to a miss when tested.

hypotheses.claim: Counting-on has had many first-try misses over earlier Sessions. Recent evidence is mostly first-try correct. Larger-first misses: 11 + 2 (p118, Hint), 11 + 1 (p96, Reveal), 7 + 2 (p32, Hint), 9 + 3 (p49, Hint), 8 + 1 (p74, Hint). Smaller-first misses: 1 + 9 (p39), 2 + 6 (p55, Reveal), 1 + 8 (p62), 3 + 7 (p72), 2 + 10 (p81, Reveal). Later first-try correct: p125, p110, p111, p107, review larger-first 8 + 3 = ? (p145), and this Session review larger-first 12 + 1 = ? (p154), which has a larger addend of 12. The evidence does not show why the misses happened.

hypotheses.claim: Make-a-ten has had several first-try misses that did not follow one simple rule. Misses include 8 + 3 (p40), 5 + 8 (p42), 8 + 7 (p50), 8 + 4 (p53), 7 + 4 (p56), 4 + 9 (p61), 7 + 7 (p88), 7 + 4 (p92), 7 + 7 (p121), review 9 + 2 (p152, solved after a Hint) and this Session 9 + 6 = ? (p157, larger-first, position 4, solved after a Hint). Many others were first-try correct (p34, p36, p43, p45, p47, p58, p59, p63, p66, p67, p68, p69, p78, p79, p99, p101, p108, p124, p131). The same fact, 7 + 7, was a Reveal twice (p88, p121) and first-try correct twice (p59, p108), so misses do not follow the addends alone.
hypotheses.nextTest: If make-a-ten comes up, note the first try, the addends and the position. p152 was at position 7 and p157 at position 4. If first-try correct, lower confidence. If it misses, note whether it is a repeat of the same kind of fact.

hypotheses.claim: Partners to 10 has been mostly reliable, but missing-partner problems with 9 as the given number missed on the first try twice in a row, each solved after a Hint (p80, p82). Later 9 + ? = 10 (p93) was first-try correct. An earlier miss with 1 as the given number (p51) ended in a Reveal. Other partner problems were first-try correct (p57, p60, p37, p73, p102, p122, p137), including review 10 - 1 = ? last Session (p147). This Session the same review 10 - 1 = ? (p162, position 9) was a first-try miss solved after a Hint. The evidence does not show a cause.

hypotheses.claim: In make-a-ten, the first four problems with a 3 or 4 as one addend were first-try misses ending in a Reveal (p40, p53, p56, p61). Then 4 + 7 (p69, p78) was first-try correct, 7 + 4 (p92) was a miss solved after a Hint, and larger-first 7 + 4 (p131), with the 4 second, was first-try correct as review. The 7 + 7 Reveals (p88, p121) had no 3 or 4, and neither did this Session's Hint-assisted miss 9 + 6 (p157). Problems with other addends were often first-try correct (p43, p58, p59, p63, p66, p68, p79, p99, p101, p108).
hypotheses.nextTest: If a make-a-ten larger-first problem with a second addend of 3 or 4 comes up again, note the first try. If it is first-try correct, mark refuted. If it misses, raise confidence.

hypotheses.claim: Unknown-addend missing-addend problems with a whole of 15 or more missed on the first try three times running: p113 (Reveal), p119 (Hint-assisted success) and p129 (Hint-assisted success). Then 10 + ? = 15 (p136) was first-try correct, and so were wholes of 14 or less (p112, p114, p115, p120, p130, p140) and 13 + ? = 15 (p146). This Session 16 - 13 = ? (p161, subtract structure, whole 16, position 8) was a first-try miss solved after a Hint. That is a different structure from the earlier misses, but it again has a whole of 16. Only first tries reach the Knowledge Estimate.

hypotheses.claim: Across five Sessions the early positions were mostly first-try correct and the first miss came at position 4 to 6. This Session positions 1 to 3 were first-try correct (p154, p155, p156), including two change-unknown problems (p155, p156). The first miss came at position 4 (p157, Hint), earlier than before. Position 5 was correct (p158) and position 7 was correct (p160). Positions 6, 8, 9 and 10 were first-try misses, each solved after a Hint (p159, p161, p162, p163). Change-unknown problems were first-try correct early (p155, p156) and missed late (p159, p163). This is a pattern in where misses fall, not a finding about why. Response time is context only.
hypotheses.nextTest: Place change-unknown problems both in the first five positions and after position 5 again. If early ones are first-try correct and later ones miss, raise confidence. If later ones are also first-try correct, lower it.

hypotheses.claim: Change-unknown misses were earlier tied to larger changes: 7 - ? = 3 (p126, change 4, Hint), 3 + ? = 8 (p134, change 5, Reveal), 8 - ? = 3 (p143, change 5, Hint). Later the pattern did not hold. Changes of 7 and 9 were first-try correct (p148, p150), a change of 6 was a Reveal (p151), and a change of 1 was a first-try miss (p153). This Session changes of 2 and 3 were first-try correct early (p155, p156), a change of 2 (13 + ? = 15, p159) was a Hint-assisted miss late, and a change of 9 (14 - ? = 5, p163) was a Hint-assisted miss late. The same size of change, 2, was correct in p155 and a miss in p159, so change size alone does not separate misses from correct answers.
hypotheses.nextTest: Give change-unknown problems in both structures with a mix of small and large changes, some early and some late. If misses still do not follow the size of the change, mark refuted. If large changes miss again, raise confidence.
